key_reasoning.reason: Touches the provider-neutral BudgetEnforcementProvider protocol (new MemberSyncItem/MemberSyncOutcome contract and sync_member_allocations method), the noop provider in the registry, the LiteLLM budget provider adapter (grouped parallel fast path with ordered fallback), a new ProjectMemberSyncExecutor abstraction, ProjectBudgetService create and equal/fixed resync flows, config and app lifespan shutdown. Base L (4+ components, new abstraction) bumped for affecting multiple workflows.

No exact precedent: a bounded thread pool with an event-loop semaphore whose slots are held through cancellation via asyncio.shield, contextvars and OTel context propagation into worker threads, and per-budget-group run batching with ensure-then-parallel-assign and fallback to ordered sync on any failure. Performance (batch throughput against LiteLLM) is the primary concern. Base L bumped for the performance red flag. The fix commit keeping batch failures per item shows the error-path semantics were subtle.

14 files changed (2436 insertions, 134 deletions): 7 source files (1 new executor module, 6 modified) and 7 test files (new executor and lifecycle suites, the rest extended) across src/codemie/configs, enterprise/litellm, rest_api, service/budget and their test trees. The diffstat maps 11-15 files to XL.
